description_en: Tests the network connectivity and authentication validity of an AI Red Teaming target
description_zh: AI Red Teaming，测试目标的网络连通性和认证有效性
name: TestConnectivity

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the attack target. If specified, the system reads Endpoint, ApiKey, ModelName, ConnectionMethod, and ConnectionConfig from the target configuration and ignores any parameters with the same names in the request. If not specified, provide the connection parameters directly in the request
parameters.help_zh: 攻击目标的唯一标识。传入后系统从目标配置中读取 Endpoint、ApiKey、ModelName、ConnectionMethod、ConnectionConfig，忽略请求中同名参数；不传时需在请求中直接提供连接参数
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en: The HTTP or HTTPS endpoint address of the target model service. This parameter is required if TargetId is empty
parameters.help_zh: 目标模型服务的 HTTP/HTTPS 端点地址。TargetId为空时必填
parameters.name: endpoint

parameters.help_en: The API key for the target model service, used to authenticate with the Endpoint. If TargetId is specified, the system reads the key from the encrypted target configuration. This parameter is required if TargetId is empty. Transmit the key over HTTPS and avoid exposing it in plaintext in logs, URLs, or client code
parameters.help_zh: 目标模型服务的 API 密钥，用于向 Endpoint 认证。传入 TargetId 时系统从已加密保存的目标配置读取。TargetId为空时必填。请通过 HTTPS 传输，避免在日志、URL 或客户端代码中明文暴露
parameters.name: api_key

parameters.help_en: The name of the target model. If ConnectionMethod is set to openai, specify the model ID under the OpenAI compatible protocol. If ConnectionMethod is set to anthropic, specify the model ID for the Anthropic Messages API. This parameter is required if the scan target is a model and TargetId is empty
parameters.help_zh:
目标模型的名称。ConnectionMethod=openai 时填 OpenAI 兼容协议下的模型 ID；ConnectionMethod=anthropic 时填 Anthropic Messages API 的模型 ID。
如果扫描对象为模型，且TargetId为空时必填
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The connection protocol type of the target service. The system selects the corresponding protocol adapter to initiate the test based on this value. Default value: openai
parameters.help_zh: 目标服务的连接协议类型。系统按此选择对应的协议适配器发起测试。默认 openai
parameters.name: connection_method
connection_config

parameters.help_en: The tracking identifier of the connectivity test. Do not specify this parameter for the first call. The system generates and returns it in the response. For subsequent calls, specify this value to query the latest status of the corresponding test
parameters.help_zh: 连通性测试的追踪标识。首次调用不传，由系统生成并在响应中返回；后续调用传入该值查询对应测试的最新状态
parameters.name: check_id

Data.description_en: The result details of the connectivity test
Data.description_zh: 连通性测试的结果详情

CheckId.description_en: The tracking identifier of the connectivity test. The system generates this value for the first call. For polling calls, this value is the same as the CheckId in the request
CheckId.description_zh: 本次连通性测试的追踪标识。首次调用由系统生成；轮询调用时与请求中的 CheckId 一致

LatencyMs.description_en: The end-to-end latency of the target service response, in milliseconds. This value may be 0 or not returned when VerifyStatus is checking
LatencyMs.description_zh: 目标服务响应的端到端延迟，单位毫秒。VerifyStatus=checking 时可能为 0 或不返回

VerifyMessage.description_en: The detailed information of the verification result. When VerifyStatus is verified, this value is a snippet of the response returned by the target service. When VerifyStatus is failed, this value describes the error cause, such as authentication failure, timeout, or empty response
VerifyMessage.description_zh: 验证结果的详细信息。VerifyStatus=verified 时为目标服务返回的响应内容片段；failed 时为错误原因描述（如认证失败、超时、空响应等）

VerifyStatus.description_en: The current status of the connectivity verification
VerifyStatus.description_zh: 连通性验证的当前状态

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, used for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪
